findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_turn_packet, get_city, get_district, get_map, get_battle_report, get_world_events, get_house_challenges, get_alliance · Public sink: get_turn_packet, get_city, get_district, get_map, get_battle_report, get_world_events, get_house_challenges, get_alliance, build, assign_line, install_ram, uninstall_ram, research, launch_satellite, trade_offer, trade_respond, train_assign, create_general, dispatch_wave, recall_wave, set_counterintel, dispatch_infiltrator, operator_query, set_standing_order, set_city_banner, found_alliance, join_alliance, leave_alliance, contribute_stockpile, found_second_city, cede_district, submit_actions, found_city.
